## Objective

Describe the technical problem or gap (not a vague wish list).

## Proposed solution

Clear description of the desired API, mode, test, or build change.

## Implementation considerations

- Fit with MCU defaults (AES-CTR + SHA-256)
- Code size / RAM impact
- Compatibility with existing `TC_AES_*`, `TC_DES*`, and `TC_*HASH*` APIs

## Testing / validation

How the change would be verified (unit tests, CAVP, Wycheproof, size).

## Additional context

Links to standards, vectors, or prior discussion.
